newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan stocks seen mixed ahead of holidays.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan stocks seen mixed ahead of holidays.

text.p: Pakistani stocks are likely to open mixed on Thursday ahead of a three-day weekend break starting Friday due to a religious holiday.
"There would be some reaction to the trade policy announced yesterday but overall the market should be mixed ahead of the long weekend," dealer Ali Asghar of Fortune Securities said.

On Wednesday, the Karachi Stock Exchange 100-index rose 1.94 points, or 0.11 percent, to close at 1,812.78 amid 138 losers and 112 gainers. Turnover fell to 60 million shares from 108 million in the previous session.
